description:
No. 82 Pinewood Estate is an exquisite three-bedroom semi-detached residence, presented to the market in truly show-house condition. Beautifully renovated in recent years, this stunning home combines contemporary style, thoughtful design and exceptional attention to detail, with every inch of space carefully considered and utilised. From the moment you step through the hall door, the quality and warmth of this gorgeous home are immediately apparent. The bright, spacious and exceptionally well-laid-out accommodation creates a welcoming atmosphere throughout, complemented by modern and stylish décor that has been carefully selected on a room-by-room basis. One of the property’s standout features is the fabulous contemporary kitchen/diner, which enjoys a wonderful outlook over the beautifully landscaped rear garden. The garden benefits from a sunny aspect and features a paved patio, covered seating area and side access, making it an ideal space for relaxing and entertaining all year round. The property boasts a host of additional features and upgrades throughout, offering prospective purchasers the opportunity to acquire a superb turnkey home with nothing to do but move in and enjoy. Pinewood Estate is a popular and well-established residential development on the outskirts of Wexford Town, offering excellent connectivity to the M/N11 road network and all major routes. Rosslare Europort is approximately 15km away, while Dublin City and Dublin Airport are approximately two hours away.
The property is ideally positioned within walking distance of Whitemill Industrial Estate and Clonard Retail Park, providing a wide range of shops, supermarkets, retail outlets and other amenities. Wexford General Hospital and Wexford Racecourse are also conveniently located nearby. The sale of No. 82 Pinewood Estate presents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a beautifully finished family home in a highly convenient location. With its superb turnkey accommodation, stylish presentation and excellent outdoor space, this is a property that is sure to appeal to a wide range of buyers. A property of this calibre and condition is rare to come to the market. Viewing is highly recommended.
